gpuLeadQuarters.description: Quarters from a chip order being placed to the chips running in a data centre.

buildingLeadQuarters.description: Quarters from committing to a data-centre building to it being ready for chips.

computeCostShare.description: Share of an AI lab's revenue that is spent on renting compute. Starting guess; the Anthropic S-1 compute commitments versus revenue are the intended anchor but are not yet in the committed data.
computeCostShare.source: assumption — Anthropic S-1 commitments vs revenue, not yet in committed data; calibrated in Task 12

overExtrapolation.description: How strongly buyers extend recent spending growth into their plans (1 means they simply continue the latest growth rate).

expectationGain.description: How fast buyers update their expectations towards what they just saw each quarter (0 means never, 1 means fully).

hyperscalerAiCapexShare.description: Share of hyperscaler capital spending that goes to AI infrastructure rather than other uses.

chipShareOfAiCapex.description: Share of AI infrastructure capital spending that buys accelerator chips (the rest is buildings, power and networking).

nvidiaShareOfAccelerators.description: Nvidia's share of accelerator spending, with the rest going to custom chips and other vendors.

nvidiaAspUsd.description: Average selling price of one Nvidia accelerator-equivalent unit, used to turn dollars into units shipped.

nvidiaGrossMargin.description: Nvidia's gross margin on sales. Starting value is the midpoint of management's 71.0%–72.0% guidance for Q4 FY27 in the 8-K of 2026-11-17.
nvidiaGrossMargin.source: NVIDIA 8-K 2026-11-17 Ex 99.1 (Q3 FY27 press release) outlook, midpoint; calibrated in Task 12

bullwhipInventoryWeeks.description: Weeks of demand that buyers and suppliers try to hold as inventory; when demand stalls the excess is worked off.

bullwhipCorrectionRate.description: Share of the gap between actual and target inventory that is corrected each quarter.

gpuEconomicLifeQuarters.description: How long an accelerator stays economically useful before newer chips make it uncompetitive.

gpuAccountingLifeQuarters.description: The period over which owners depreciate accelerators in their accounts (six years).
gpuAccountingLifeQuarters.source: assumption — hyperscaler depreciation policy of about six years

labShareDrift.description: How quickly spending shifts between AI labs towards the ones with better results each quarter.

defaultRunwayQuarters.description: Cash runway (in quarters of obligations) below which a lab or cloud provider is treated as defaulting; 0 means cash must stay positive.

defaultContractQuarters.description: Typical length of a compute contract signed by a lab, used when a deal has no stated end date.

aiAddressableWageBillUsd.description: Yearly wage bill of the work that AI could plausibly take over, the ceiling for labour-substitution spending. Rough placeholder, no committed source yet; refine from BLS or OECD figures.
aiAddressableWageBillUsd.source: assumption — rough placeholder; no BLS/OECD figure committed yet

cowosUnitsPerQuarter.description: Most accelerators that advanced chip packaging (CoWoS) can produce in a quarter. About 120k wafers a month at end-2026 x 3 months x ~12 packages per wafer x ~0.7 yield and mix.
cowosUnitsPerQuarter.source: secondary — research_notes existing_ai_models_data.md section 2 (JPM, TrendForce, EffectStory CoWoS estimates 105k–140k wpm); analyst estimates, conversion is a heuristic not verified

hbmUnitsPerQuarter.description: Most accelerators that high-bandwidth memory supply can feed in a quarter. No HBM bit-supply figure was retrieved in the research notes, so this is a placeholder set slightly above the packaging ceiling.
hbmUnitsPerQuarter.source: assumption — research notes found no 2026 HBM bit-supply figure (existing_ai_models_data.md section 2); placeholder

kwPerAccelerator.description: All-in facility power drawn per accelerator, including cooling and networking. Implied by Epoch: about 2 million accelerators drawing about 9 GW.
kwPerAccelerator.source: secondary — Epoch AI supercomputer trends via AI CERTs, in research_notes existing_ai_models_data.md section 1 (9 GW / 2M accelerators)

powerLoadFactor.description: Share of contracted data-centre power that is actually available to run accelerators at any time.

tsmcShareOfChipCost.description: Share of an accelerator's selling price that is paid to TSMC for wafers and packaging.

skHynixShareOfChipCost.description: Share of an accelerator's selling price that is paid to SK hynix for high-bandwidth memory.

asmlShareOfTsmcCapex.description: Share of TSMC's capital spending that goes to ASML lithography tools.

cloudOperatingCostRatio.description: Operating costs other than depreciation and interest (power, staff, leases) as a share of cloud-provider revenue.

labOperatingCostRatio.description: Operating costs of an AI lab other than compute (staff, sales, research) as a share of its revenue.
